# Platform specs

<!-- Generated by scripts/build.mjs from src/specs.js. Edit that file, not this one. -->

What brandshot renders, at which size, and where the text goes. "Text area" is the `content` box: the part every device shows that no avatar or app UI covers.

### YouTube

| File | What | Size | Text area | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `youtube-profile` | Channel picture | 800×800 | centre 70% (circle crop) | Shown as a circle, rendered as small as 98×98. JPG/PNG/GIF/BMP, ≤ 15 MB. |
| `youtube-banner` | Channel banner | 2560×1440 | x 531–2029, y 525–916 | Min 2048×1152 (16:9), recommended 2560×1440, ≤ 6 MB. Text and logos stay inside the centred 1546×423 safe area; TV shows the whole image, desktop a 2560×423 strip. |

### Instagram

| File | What | Size | Text area | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `instagram-profile` | Profile picture | 1080×1080 | centre 70% (circle crop) | Shown as a circle at 110×110 (320×320 is plenty). Also used by Threads by default. |
| `instagram-post` | Feed post (3:4) | 1080×1440 | x 96–984, y 104–1336 | 1080×1440 (3:4), the tallest ratio Instagram keeps uncropped. Since 2025 the profile grid shows 3:4 tiles, so this fills a tile exactly. 4:5 and 1:1 posts get their sides trimmed on the grid. |
| `instagram-square` | Square post (1:1) | 1080×1080 | x 88–992, y 88–992 | 1080×1080. Also works as a LinkedIn, Facebook or X feed image. |
| `instagram-story` | Story / Reel cover | 1080×1920 | x 80–1000, y 269–1500 | 1080×1920 (9:16). Meta's safe zone keeps the top 14% (269 px) and 6% each side clear; Reels overlay captions and buttons on the bottom 35%. Text stops 420 px from the bottom, tiles may extend lower. |

### LinkedIn

| File | What | Size | Text area | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `linkedin-profile` | Profile photo (personal) | 800×800 | centre 70% (circle crop) | Min 400×400, shown as a circle. JPG/PNG, ≤ 8 MB. |
| `linkedin-logo` | Company page logo | 400×400 | centre 70% (circle crop) | 400×400 (min 268×268), shown as a rounded square. PNG/JPG, ≤ 3 MB. Transparent logos are shown on white. |
| `linkedin-personal-banner` | Personal background | 1584×396 | x 380–1346, y 48–348 | 1584×396 (4:1), JPG/PNG ≤ 8 MB. The photo covers roughly x 40–350, y 170–396 on desktop, and the mobile app trims ~15% off each side, so text sits between x 380 and 1346. |
| `linkedin-company-cover` | Company page cover | 1512×256 | x 290–1402, y 28–228 | 1512×256 is now both the minimum and the recommended size (1128×191 is outdated). PNG/JPG ≤ 3 MB. The logo covers the lower-left and LinkedIn asks to keep the lower-right clear. |

### X

| File | What | Size | Text area | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `x-profile` | Profile photo | 400×400 | centre 70% (circle crop) | 400×400, shown as a circle. JPG/PNG/GIF, ≤ 2 MB. |
| `x-header` | Header | 1500×500 | x 420–1436, y 72–428 | 1500×500 (3:1), JPG/PNG/GIF ≤ 5 MB. X may cut up to 60 px from the top and bottom, and the avatar covers about x 0–400, y 330–500. |

### Facebook

| File | What | Size | Text area | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `facebook-profile` | Profile picture | 720×720 | centre 70% (circle crop) | Min 320×320, shown as a circle at 176 px (desktop) / 196 px (phone). PNG keeps logos and text sharp. |
| `facebook-cover` | Cover photo | 1640×924 | x 220–1500, y 190–734 | Min 400×150. Facebook shows the cover at several ratios (16:9, 2.4:1, 2.63:1); 1640×924 covers all of them and the centred 1640×624 band is always visible. The profile picture covers the lower-left. |

## Profile text limits

| Platform | Limits (characters) |
| --- | --- |
| YouTube | Channel description: 1,000 · Channel name: 50 · Handle: 30 |
| Instagram | Bio: 150 · Name: 30 · Username: 30 |
| LinkedIn | Headline (personal): 220 · About (personal): 2,600 · Tagline (company): 120 · About (company): 2,000 |
| X | Bio: 160 · Display name: 50 |
| Facebook | Page bio: 101 |
| TikTok | Bio: 80 |
| Bluesky | Bio: 256 · Display name: 64 |
| Threads | Bio: 150 |
| Pinterest | About: 500 |

Avatar-overlap regions and some profile-picture sizes are not documented by the platforms. They were measured from current layouts and secondary guides (Hootsuite, Kapwing, Snappa), so treat them as close approximations.

## Recent changes that most guides still get wrong

- **LinkedIn company cover:** 1512×256 (was 1128×191).
- **Instagram:** the profile grid shows 3:4 tiles, and feed photos are kept between 1.91:1 and 3:4, so 1080×1440 fills a tile exactly.
- **X header:** up to 60 px can be cut from the top and bottom.
- **YouTube thumbnails:** up to 3840×2160 and 50 MB.
- **Facebook cover:** shown at several ratios (16:9, 2.4:1, 2.63:1). 1640×924 with the text inside the centred 1640×624 band covers all of them.
